---
title: "R Notebook"
output: html_notebook
---
```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(dplyr)
here()

COG.master <- read.csv(here("00_data", "03_func_data", "func_metadata", "mastercog.csv"), header=TRUE)

COG.meta <- read.delim2(here("00_data", "03_func_data", "func_metadata", "cog-20.def.tab"), header=FALSE)
COG.meta <- COG.meta[,c(1,2,3,4,5)]
colnames(COG.meta) <- c("ID", "COGlet", "gene_desc", "gene_name", "gene_cat")

### deal with multi-letter cogs  by making them "unknown"
COG.meta$COGlet <- ifelse(nchar(COG.meta$COGlet) > 1, "S", COG.meta$COGlet)

## change virus COG to custom "Ph" category (phage)
COG.meta$COGlet <- ifelse(COG.meta$COGlet=="X", "Ph", COG.meta$COGlet)

### add in no hit category
COG.meta<- COG.meta %>%
  add_row(
    ID = "NO_HIT",
    COGlet = "0",
    gene_desc = "NO_HIT",
    gene_name = "NO_HIT",
    gene_cat = "NO_HIT"
  )


COG.meta$source <- "COG"


PHROG.meta <- read.delim2(here("00_data", "03_func_data", "func_metadata", "phrog_annot_v4.tsv"))
PHROG.meta$phrog <- "phrog"
PHROG.meta <- PHROG.meta %>% unite("phrog_id", c("phrog", "phrog_num"), sep = "_")
PHROG.meta$COGlet <- "Ph"
PHROG.meta$gene_name <- PHROG.meta$phrog_annot
colnames(PHROG.meta) <- c("ID", "gene_desc", "gene_cat", "COGlet", "gene_name")
PHROG.meta$source <- "PHROG"

meta.func <- bind_rows(COG.meta, PHROG.meta)
meta.func[is.na(meta.func)] <- "no data"

meta.func <- merge(meta.func, COG.master, by="COGlet", all.x=TRUE, all.y=FALSE)

meta.func$gene_cat <- ifelse(meta.func$gene_cat=="", "unknown function", meta.func$gene_cat)

meta.func <- select(meta.func, COGlet, ID, gene_name, gene_desc, gene_cat, COG.broad, Cog.cat, Nog.abbrev, Nog.new, source)

meta.func$DetailedCat <- ifelse(meta.func$COGlet=="Ph", meta.func$gene_cat, meta.func$Nog.abbrev)

meta.func$gene_name <- ifelse(meta.func$gene_name=="", meta.func$gene_desc, meta.func$gene_name)


### to remove weird utf 8 text formatting issues
bad <- which(!validUTF8(meta.func$gene_desc))

meta.func$gene_desc[bad]

meta.func$gene_desc[bad] <- iconv(meta.func$gene_desc[bad], from = "", to = "UTF-8", sub = "")




write.csv(meta.func, here("00_data", "03_func_data", "func_metadata", "mastercog_phrog.csv"))
```
